characters.name: 江野
characters.design: 16-year-old Chinese teen male ping pong player, short messy sweat-dripping hair, red sweat-soaked jersey clinging to his back, wrist wrapped with white kinesio tape, stubborn determined gaze, lean athletic build, full body front view suitable for dynamic training action shots.

characters.name: 江建军
characters.design: 45-year-old Chinese man, Jiang Ye's father and training partner, short cropped hair with visible silver strands, worn old sports jacket with frayed shiny cuffs, hard defined forearm muscles, neutral expressionless face, sturdy build, full body front/side view suitable for training interaction shots.

issues: 画面为半身视图，非设计要点要求的全身视图
背景出现重复人物（AI生成伪影）
运动外套袖口未呈现明显磨损发亮特征

props.name: 乒乓球拍
props.design: Standard ping pong paddle with black rubber surface, worn from long-term use, fits both Jiang Ye's frustrated floor slam and Jiang Jianjun's fast accurate feed shots, suitable for close-up and full body prop display shots.

issues: 左侧球员球拍为红色橡胶面，与设计要点要求的黑色橡胶面不符
球拍未见明显长期使用磨损痕迹
画面为双人对战场景，非设计要点要求的道具展示镜头

props.name: 乒乓球
props.design: Standard white 40mm ping pong balls, some scattered on worn wooden floor, some stored in full woven baskets, natural matte texture under mixed lighting, suitable for close-up action and prop still shots.

scenes.name: 老球馆训练区
scenes.design: Gritty realistic old training gym, worn warm brown wooden floor, high windows letting in soft cool dawn light, warm overhead incandescent lights, faded old honor flags on walls, woven baskets full of ping pong balls, visible sweat stains on floor, suitable for cinematic wide shots capturing the whole training space.

issues: 光线为室内人工照明，非设计要点要求的柔和冷冽晨光
右下角编织篮中可见彩色球，非白色乒乓球
地板过于整洁光滑，缺乏 gritty 粗砺质感
